method: built-in image_gen edits; one call per angle

jobs.name: 01-front-driver-quarter.png
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one photorealistic front driver three-quarter keyframe for a 360-degree orbit of this actual grey 2004 Toyota Land Cruiser 100.
Image 1 is the edit target: preserve its EXACT front driver three-quarter camera angle, framing, vehicle position and scale, 16:9 canvas, beach geography, horizon, sand, vegetation, ocean, lighting and shadows. The beach world already rotates correctly with the camera in the set. Do not reinterpret the view or replace the background.
Images 2-4 are real-car reference photos ONLY for vehicle hardware, never composition/background. Image 2 is authoritative for current black grille. Image 3 is authoritative for roof crossbars, wheels and stance. Image 4 supports the real rear two-inch receiver; keep hatch closed as in target. References have priority over the old target for hardware geometry.
EDIT ONLY: simplify and correct the existing roof system to EXACTLY TWO straight SLIM BLACK Malone transverse crossbars spanning vehicle left-right, one front bar above the front-seat/B-pillar area and one rear bar above the rear-quarter window, each attached by two practical COMPACT BLACK clamp feet matching image 3. Bars have a narrow rectangular profile, small black capped ends and modest overhang beyond feet. Their tops sit low above the roof, feet must be small squat practical clamps, not tall elegant swooping pedestals. Retain only the factory fore-aft longitudinal rails evidenced by the photo, low close to roof. No giant silver arches, no additional transverse bars, no doubled bars, no basket or platform, no spoiler. Two bars must be geometrically consistent in this perspective (bars end-on in side profiles). Bare roof bars only.
Where the front is visible, match image 2's genuine black TOYOTA grille: large spaced block letters TOYOTA on the chunky central black horizontal section, big chunky rectangular/angled rectangular openings in one row above and below, not tiny fine honeycomb mesh. Keep grille overall aperture and original headlights/bumper shape. Preserve all other body details.
Consistency constraints repeated for all frames: grey 2004 LC100, modest OME 1.5-inch suspension lift, stock silver five-spoke Toyota wheels, BFGoodrich KM3 mud-terrain tires with modest Bora spacer stance; no exaggerated lift or tires. EXACTLY TWO slim straight black Malone crossbars with compact black clamp feet and no extra rack. A centered 2-inch receiver under the rear bumper when visible, no trailer, no cargo attachments. No people, cargo or camping accessories. Do not add missing-trim damage at an invented location; retain the target's existing appearance. Preserve blank plate treatment and rear decals where already visible. Keep photorealism. Make a SINGLE edited image, never a montage/contact sheet. Output same landscape proportions as image 1.
